One registry value under HKLM on a Windows host. The value's type and data are compared with what's there, without expanding environment names.

Use `windows_registry_value` to set one value under `HKLM` on a Windows host. A value of type `expand_string` is compared as stored, with `%PATH%` left as `%PATH%`, so it doesn't show as changed on every plan.

## Example usage

```hcl
step "long_paths" {
  windows_registry_value {
    key  = "HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\FileSystem"
    name = "LongPathsEnabled"
    type = "dword"
    data = "1"
  }
}
```

```hcl
step "app_dirs" {
  windows_registry_value {
    key  = "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\MyApp"
    name = "Folders"
    type = "multi_string"
    data = "C:\\app\nC:\\data"
  }
}
```

A secret stays out of the plan and state:

```hcl
step "api_token" {
  windows_registry_value {
    key     = "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\MyApp"
    name    = "Token"
    type    = "string"
    data_wo = "use an ephemeral variable here"
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | string | One of | The data: a decimal number for dword and qword, hex for binary, one value per line for multi_string. Set this or data_wo. |
| `data_wo` | string | One of | Like data, but kept out of state: state records only data_hmac. Use it for secrets. |
| `key` | string | Yes | Key under HKLM, such as HKLM\SOFTWARE\App. Created if it's missing. |
| `name` | string | No | Value name. Leave unset for the key's default value. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the value, "delete" removes the value and leaves the key. |
| `type` | string | Yes | "string", "expand_string", "multi_string", "dword", "qword" or "binary". |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_windows_registry_value.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data_hmac` | string | HMAC-SHA256 of data_wo, keyed by CONN3X_HMAC_KEY or ~/.config/conn3x/hmac.key. Null when data is used. |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the value matched at the last refresh. A secret's change shows here only. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_windows_registry_value` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.

## How it works

**Data.** `dword` and `qword` take a decimal number, `binary` takes hex such as `0aff`, and `multi_string` takes one value per line.

**Secrets.** `data_wo` travels on stdin. A refresh asks the host for the SHA-256 of the value and compares a keyed hash with state, so drift still shows and the secret doesn't come back. Registry permissions decide who else can read it: `HKLM` values are readable by every user unless the key says otherwise, so a secret here needs a key you've locked down.

**Keys.** A missing key is created. Only `HKLM` is supported, in the 64-bit view.

## Removal

By default, deleting a `windows_registry_value` step leaves the value. With `on_remove = "delete"` it deletes the value and leaves the key.
